fields.value: Replication Data for: Snowfall increase counters glacier demise in Kunlun Shan and Karakoram

dsDescriptionValue.value: Data to reproduce figures in the paper "Irrigation-induced snowfall increase counters glacier demise in Kunlun Shan and Karakoram" (bibliographic details TBD). Data files are WRF monthly mean precipitation and snow (mm_prcp_*.nc in mm) and 2-meter temperature (mm_temp_*.nc in K), annual glacier volume, area and mass balance per 1x1 degree bin (glacier_mb_1x1.nc), and annual moisture sources for the Kunlun Shan - Karakoram snowfall (Moisturesources_kunlun.nc in mm). Format is NetCDF4. More detailed data is available from the authors upon request.

keywordValue.value: Annual glacier volume, area and mass balance

publicationCitation.value: de Kok, R. J., Kraaijenbrink, P. D. A., Tuinenburg, O. A., Bonekamp, P. N. J., and Immerzeel, W. W.: Snowfall increase counters glacier demise in Kunlun Shan and Karakoram, The Cryosphere Discuss.

fields.value: In version 2.0 two monthly mean precipitation files (1999 and 2006) have been replaced, because the initial files contain deficiencies.

https://www.mmm.ucar.edu/weather-research-and-forecasting-model (WRF website)
https://www.nature.com/articles/nature23878 (Description of glacier model and links to code and data)
https://www.ecmwf.int/en/forecasts/datasets/reanalysis-datasets/era-interim (ERA-Interim website)
